findings.title: Operator identity map and revocation are implemented; single-operator fallback still allowed
evidence: src/falcon_control/service.py:235-239 resolves operator_identities + operator_revoked at startup
src/falcon_control/service.py:337-345 operator role granted only on cert-fingerprint match
findings.impact: Authorization is fingerprint-bound and multi-operator capable; the single-operator fallback (`operator` id) remains for labs, so the matrix's weakest path is that shared default identity.
findings.recommendation: For production, require operator_identities (non-empty) and refuse the default fallback; document the matrix in the audit.
findings.note: multi-operator implemented; fallback retained for lab
